full_prompt_en: The image is a square, mural-like digital illustration divided into two close vertical panels, each presenting a front-facing yellow figure against a cream-and-ochre tiled ground. A narrow white strip separates the panels, and a thin pale border keeps both portraits within the square. The backgrounds are built from countless small rectangles and squares, some pale cream and others golden brown, like worn ceramic mosaic or patched wall paint. In the left panel, a figure with a broad rectangular head and dark rounded hair looks straight forward. Large round brown eyes sit beneath a flat yellow brow, with a short dark nose and a slight closed smile. Small blocklike ears project from either side. A yellow ochre collared shirt fills the lower half, its plum-red collar, vertical seam, little chest pocket, and buttonlike marks picked out from the tiled surface. In the right panel, a second yellow figure has a rounder head beneath a low orange-gold cap with tiny raised studs. One eye faces outward while the other is covered by a round dark lens held to the face by a yellow hand. The lens has nested rings of black, muted blue, and green, making it the sharpest circular feature in the composition. A plum-colored side shape extends behind the cap, and the figure's shirt is a brighter patchwork of red, pink, ochre, and muted green rectangles. Both figures have simplified almost toy-like features, straight shoulders, and frontal stillness. Fine grid lines, scuffs, and uneven pigment run across their faces, clothing, and background, joining them into one textured plane. Light appears as broad even illumination rather than a visible source, with shallow gray-brown shadow around features and along the lens. The overall composition is playful and symmetrical in its two-column rhythm, while the differing head shapes and patchwork colors give each figure its own character.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、壁画般的数字插画，分为相邻的两道竖栏，每栏都有一位正面朝向的黄色人物，背景是奶油与赭黄拼砖。窄白条分开两栏，细浅色边框把两幅肖像留在方形之内。背景由无数小长方和方块组成，有浅奶油也有金褐，像磨旧陶瓷马赛克或修补过的墙漆。左栏人物的头部宽而呈矩形，深色圆弧头发贴在顶上，直视前方。大而圆的棕眼在平直黄眉下，鼻子短而深，嘴唇轻轻闭合微笑。小小的块状耳朵从两侧伸出。黄赭色翻领衬衫填满下半部，紫红衣领、竖缝、胸前小口袋和纽扣般痕迹从拼砖表面中显出。右栏，第二位黄色人物的头更圆，戴着低低的橙金色帽子，上有细小凸点。一只眼睛朝外，另一只被举在脸前的圆形深色镜头遮住。镜头有黑、低调蓝和绿色同心圈，是构图中最锐利的圆形特征。帽后延伸出紫红色侧形，人物的衬衫由更鲜亮的红、粉、赭黄和低调绿矩形拼接。两个人的五官都简化得近乎玩具，肩线平直，正面姿态静止。细网格、擦痕和不均匀色素贯穿面孔、衣装与背景，将其接成同一有纹理的平面。光是宽阔而均匀的照明，没有可见光源，五官周围和镜头边只有浅浅灰褐阴影。整体构图因双栏节奏而俏皮且对称，不同头形与拼接色又给各人物独特性格。
style_prompt_en: A mural-like illustration builds surfaces from tightly packed small rectangles, fine grid lines, scuffs, and uneven blocks of pigment. Mustard yellow dominates broad focal shapes, while cream, ochre, muted plum, red, and green appear in smaller tiled accents. Large simplified contours remain clear against the busy microtexture; rounded and squared forms alternate, making the image playful without losing order. Shading is shallow and graphic, with dark narrow edges and concentric accents drawing attention to selected details. Even light preserves the sense of a flat painted wall while tiny value changes suggest gentle volume. Repeated vertical divisions and near-symmetrical spacing organize the frame. The overall finish is tactile, colorful, and charming, with mosaic texture unifying focal shapes and background.
style_prompt_zh: 这种壁画式插画以紧密小矩形、细网格、擦痕和不均匀色素块构造表面。芥黄主导宽阔焦点形，奶油、赭黄、低调紫红、红与绿则出现在较小拼砖强调中。大而简化的轮廓在繁忙的微纹理前仍清楚；圆形与方形交替，让画面俏皮而不失秩序。阴影浅而图形化，以细窄深边和同心强调把注意引向选定细节。均匀光保留平面绘墙的感觉，细小明暗变化又暗示轻微体积。重复竖向分隔与近对称间距组织画幅。整体完成面可触、多彩而迷人，马赛克肌理统一焦点形体与背景。
theme_en: A two-panel mural-like image of yellow geometric faces, one holding a round lens
theme_zh: 一幅双栏壁画式画面：两张黄色几何面孔，其中一人举着圆形镜头
name: Os Gemeos
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
